messages:
rachael: Heads up — console is showing a bunch of quota attributed to `unknown-route` since yesterday canary. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: yep, noticed a spike in misattributed tokens in the quota dashboard. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/quotas?since=24h :eyes:

anya: I traced a few traces — SDKs started shipping a new header last week: `X-Route-Meta`. Some clients send plain JSON, some send base64(JSON). Console parsing expects the plain JSON shape, so base64 payloads fail and fallback to `unknown-route`.

mike: that explains it. Do we know which SDKs switched formats?

anya: python & node releases 0.9.1 included base64-encoding from a helper lib. go stayed plain. Example payloads:

```
# plain
X-Route-Meta: {"route":"billing","quota_key":"team-prod"}

# base64
X-Route-Meta: eyJyb3V0ZSI6ImJpbGxpbmciLCJxdW90YV9rZXkiOiJ0ZWFtLXByb2QifQ==
```

rachael: ugh. Any customer visible impact besides the dashboard? Quota enforcement? billing?

anya: enforcement still uses route_id in the token ledger so charges are fine. This is primarily attribution/telemetry & console UX — ~0.6% of requests show unknown-route, ~0.2% quota misattribution on recent samples.

james: ops idea: make console parsing tolerant — accept JSON, try base64 decode and parse, else fallback. Should be a small change and lowers blast radius.

mike: agree. Short-term console patch + non-breaking SDK rev to restore plain JSON by default. Then coordinate a proper migration with an opt-in header format flag.

rachael: plan proposal: 1) console tolerant parsing (owner: mike) 2) revert python/node helper in 0.9.2 to send plain JSON (owner: anya) 3) add SDK feature flag `route_meta_format: "base64"|"json"` for explicit opt-in, release in next minor 4) add telemetry alerts if parser sees >0.1% unknown routes post-rollout. Can we do canary?

mike: canary for console patch to prod-1 && prod-2, then 24h watch. I'll open a PR and a canary deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/console-routemeta-tolerant -> prod-1 (sha: a1b2c3d)

anya: for SDKs, I can put the revert branch up today and publish a patch. Will add the feature flag change as a minor semver so it's opt-in. Example quick config: `Client(route_meta_format="json")`

james: long-term we should document the header format in the API reference and add a console indicator when data is coming from legacy/opt-in formats so customers can triage.

rachael: agreed. Also add a short blurb to the changelog and send a note to #customers about the UI weirdness while we patch.

mike: adding a dashboard tile to surface recent unknown-route rate (owner: me). I'll link the PR once ready.

deploy-bot: deploy success: canary/console-routemeta-tolerant -> prod-1 (sha: a1b2c3d) :white_check_mark:

anya: patch release created for python 0.9.2 and node 0.9.2 (revert helper). Publishing in ~30m.

rachael: thanks all. Owners: mike (console patch + tile), anya (SDK patch), james (docs + changelog), rachael (customer comms). Check back in 24h and we can decide on opt-in schedule. :thumbsup:

mike: noted. if anything spikes I'll @-ping on this thread.

anya: will monitor package publish + install telemetry.

james: I'll draft the docs PR after SDK publish.

rachael: closing loop — feel free to @rachael if you hit blockers.
